plan.why: Its Flask server is small, so llocal rewrites it in Go on llocal's kit. A Go server starts in a moment and needs little memory, so the app is quick and can sleep when nobody is using it.
found: An app with its own Flask server.
2 server routes, like GET /api/invoices and GET /api/invoices/{invoice_id}.pdf.
A PostgreSQL database, with 1 table: invoices.

left.text: It comes with Docker files, which llocal doesn't run: anything they install or start besides the app has to go, or move into the app.
Its data is in PostgreSQL (1 table) and moves into one SQLite file beside the app.
Its data is in Redis and moves into one SQLite file beside the app.
Its Flask server (2 routes in 1 file, 1 KB) is rewritten in Go on llocal's kit.
It has no llocal.json yet: the short file that tells llocal how to build and start it.

changes.text: The PostgreSQL and Redis data moves into one SQLite file on llocal, copied over once.
changes.detail: SQLite sits right next to the app, so it is fast, it is backed up with the app, and only people who can open the app reach the data.

changes.text: The Flask server is rewritten in Go on llocal's kit, answering at the same addresses.
changes.detail: A Go server starts in a moment and needs little memory, so the app is quick and can sleep when nobody is using it.

needs.text: So we can copy your data once: the full address of your PostgreSQL database, like the one in DATABASE_URL, with a user that can read all of it. It is used for the copy, then thrown away.
So we can copy your data once: the full address of your Redis database, like the one in REDIS_URL, with a user that can read all of it. It is used for the copy, then thrown away.

blockers.title: It comes with Docker files
blockers.detail: We found Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml. llocal does not run Docker: it builds the app from its own code, in llocal's standard setup for Node, Python or Go. Dockerfile installs wkhtmltopdf, which the app may need. docker-compose.yml starts 3 services: web, db and cache.
blockers.way_out: If they only install and start the app, there is nothing to do: llocal leaves them out. A database in them becomes SQLite on llocal. If the app needs other programs installed, or another service from them, tell us which, or upload that service as its own app.
